shortDescription: German sportswear maker Adidas XETR:ADS on Tuesday raised its full-year profit outlook and reported a 37% increase in third-quarter operating profit.($1 = 0.8902 euros)

children: on Tuesday raised its full-year profit outlook and reported a 37% increase in third-quarter operating profit.
Third-quarter operating profit rose to a record €1.008 billion ($1.1 billion) from €736 million a year earlier
The company said operating profit for the full year would be around €100 million more than previously expected
Adidas made the statements in an unscheduled earnings release ahead of its full earnings report scheduled for October 29
